name: Configure a valid fair launch and preview capped allocation
expected: Allocation totals 100%, public pool is 70% of supply, and wallet ceiling is 2% of the public pool.

name: Block an invalid allocation policy
expected: A visible validation message states that allocation must total exactly 100% and no launch transaction is created.

name: Inspect the deterministic allocation proof
expected: The proof screen shows requested versus final allocations and identifies capped-pro-rata-v1 as deterministic.

name: Verify the policy proof directly against Devnet
expected: The confirmed transaction is read and the on-chain memo matches the committed policy proof.

name: Show Devnet transaction verification state
expected: The app exposes the proof hash, mint address and Solana Explorer transaction link.
